taiwan_aviation.headline: 澳門航空 A321neo B-MBU 抵達桃園
taiwan_aviation.summary: 公開 ADS-B 觀測顯示，澳門航空（NX／AMU）註冊號 B-MBU 的 Airbus A321neo 於 8 月 9 日抵達桃園；澳門民航局登記資料列明其精確型號為 A321-271NX。
taiwan_aviation.headline_en: Air Macau A321neo B-MBU Arrives at Taiwan Taoyuan
taiwan_aviation.summary_en: Public ADS-B observations show Air Macau Airbus A321neo B-MBU arrived at Taiwan Taoyuan International Airport on August 9. Macao's civil aviation authority lists the aircraft as an Airbus A321-271NX operated by Air Macau.

international_aviation.headline: 墨爾本機場空中巴士A380航班增加32% 新加坡航空同步擴增
international_aviation.summary: 根據Simple Flying報導，墨爾本機場的空中巴士A380客機航班大幅成長，在11月至3月期間將增加109架次超大型客機起飛，整體增幅達32%。此外，新加坡航空亦在年底之際增加25%的空中巴士A380航班。
international_aviation.headline_en: Melbourne Airport Sees 32% Boost in Airbus A380 Flights as Singapore Airlines Expands Capacity
international_aviation.summary_en: According to reporting by Simple Flying, Melbourne Airport is set for a 32% increase in Airbus A380 superjumbo flights between November and March, adding 109 extra departures as a carrier reintroduces heavy widebody aircraft capacity on its network. Concurrently, Singapore Airlines is expanding its global Airbus A380 schedule by 25% around the turn of the year, reflecting increased deployment of heavy widebody jetliners across international long-haul routes. Separately, historical records show Qantas previously scheduled its final Airbus A380 service between Melbourne and Los Angeles for October 24 before transitioning the long-haul route to Boeing 787-9 aircraft.

international_aviation.headline: 阿聯酋航空2026年夏季暫停布拉格與格拉斯哥A380航班
international_aviation.summary: 根據Simple Flying報導，阿聯酋航空已於2026年夏季暫時停止前往布拉格與格拉斯哥的空中巴士A380航班服務。該航空公司預計於同年10月恢復這兩條長途航線的每日A380巨無霸客機服務。此項調整影響了該航空公司在夏季期間對這兩個歐洲目的地的機型派遣規劃。
international_aviation.headline_en: Emirates Temporarily Suspends Airbus A380 Flights to Prague and Glasgow for Summer 2026
international_aviation.summary_en: According to a report by Simple Flying, Emirates has temporarily suspended its Airbus A380 flights to Prague and Glasgow for the summer 2026 season. The airline plans to restore daily superjumbo services to both of these long-haul destinations in October 2026. The temporary suspension affects scheduled operations to the Czech and Scottish cities during the summer months, with normal daily Airbus A380 service returning later in the year as part of the carrier's broader network updates.

ground_and_maritime.headline: 颱風白海豚影響 華航調整8月10日上海航班
ground_and_maritime.summary: 受颱風白海豚影響，中華航空宣布2026年8月10日松山往返上海虹橋CI201/CI202航班取消，桃園與高雄往返上海浦東航班延後並放大機型。此外，國籍航空亦針對沖繩航線採取放大機型與加開班機等疏運措施。
ground_and_maritime.headline_en: Typhoon White Dolphin Prompts China Airlines Shanghai Flight Adjustments
ground_and_maritime.summary_en: Due to the impact of Typhoon White Dolphin, China Airlines announced adjustments for its flights between Taiwan and Shanghai on August 10, cancelling flights CI201 and CI202 between Taipei Songshan and Shanghai Hongqiao. Additionally, services CI501 and CI502 from Taoyuan to Shanghai Pudong, alongside CI583 and CI584 from Kaohsiung to Shanghai Pudong, will be delayed and operated with larger aircraft. Other Taiwanese carriers, including EVA Air and STARLUX Airlines, have also deployed upscaled aircraft and extra flights to accommodate passengers affected on Okinawa routes.

ground_and_maritime.headline: David Cummins宣誓就任美國運輸安全管理局第八任局長
ground_and_maritime.summary: 美國參議院通過確認案後，David Cummins已正式宣誓就任美國運輸安全管理局（TSA）第八任局長。他在2026年5月獲美國總統川普提名，將領導約6萬名員工，負責全美430多座機場及鐵路、管道與海運等陸上交通系統的安全監管作業。
ground_and_maritime.headline_en: David Cummins Sworn In as Eighth TSA Administrator Following Senate Confirmation
ground_and_maritime.summary_en: David Cummins has been sworn in as the eighth Administrator of the Transportation Security Administration (TSA) following his confirmation by the US Senate. Nominated by US President Donald Trump in May 2026, Cummins takes charge of an agency with around 60,000 employees. In his new role, he will oversee security operations at more than 430 airports across the United States, as well as surface transportation sectors including rail, mass transit, highways, pipelines, and maritime networks. Cummins stated that he plans to focus on the TSA workforce, improving employee morale, and deploying advanced technology at security checkpoints.
